decision: six goals: notifications while the Android app is closed, Windows auto-update, earlier conversations, a terminal key row with two small touch fixes, phone checks of dark mode and the cards, then green suites and release 0.3.19
why: the user asked for all listed improvements

decision: left out UI updates through the hub and fork into a worktree
why: recommended last turn as not worth it yet; the user did not object

decision: notices move to the hub, which knows each transition exactly, and the native Rust shell shows them on every platform; a small Android foreground service keeps the process and SSH link alive in the background, with a switch to turn it off
why: the app's own diffing runs in JavaScript, which Android pauses in the background; deciding where the transitions happen removes the batching guesswork too

decision: background connection instead of Firebase push
why: no Google project, no third party, works with the Obtainium-installed APK; costs a permanent notification and some battery; the user can ask for push instead

decision: two workers in their own worktrees: earlier conversations; terminal key row and small touch fixes; the main session does notifications and the updater
why: independent files mostly; only the main session installs the hub and uses the phone

decision: U1 on the Nord: with orfoni in the background, a session needing approval shows a notification titled with the session, also under forced Doze with the battery exemption declined
why: prove it on the real phone, not the unit tests
evidence: app/e2e-android/android.spec.ts, 36.6s pass; dumpsys showed orfoni's own notices

decision: the foreground service alone keeps the network through Doze; the battery exemption only guards against phone makers' app killers
why: the first run passed with orfoni off the exemption list, because the test's Allow tap missed the capitalised ALLOW button
evidence: dumpsys deviceidle whitelist count 0 after a passing Doze run; askedBatteryLimits was true
result: comment in BackgroundPlugin.kt corrected; test now declines the dialog by button id and asserts the exemption is off

decision: U2: Tauri updater 2.14.0 (17 days old), passive install, check at start and every 6 h, an Update to <version> button under the orfoni name; no platform gate, the phone's failed check shows nothing
why: experience first: one click, no auto-restart in the middle of work; laziness: the plugin's absence on Android is the gate

decision: U2 signing: a key made with tauri signer, no passphrase, signs with an empty password; tools/check-update.mjs verifies the signature against tauri.conf.json's public key and rejects a file with one changed byte; CI runs it before publishing
why: prove the key, the config and the CI format agree before a release depends on them
evidence: local sign + verify pass; tampered exit 1

decision: held tauri-plugin-updater at 2.14.0 and rustls-webpki 0.103.15, webpki-root-certs 1.0.9, openssl-probe 0.2.1, the transitive crates under two weeks old
why: two-week rule for new code; no advisory affects the held versions (GitHub advisory DB)

decision: writing the TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY repository secret was refused by the auto-mode classifier; asked Manuel to run gh secret set himself
why: secret-store writes need him; the workflow fails loudly without it rather than ship an unsigned update

decision: U3 live: hub e2e and app e2e for earlier conversations pass against real Claude Code after two fixes
why: the worker wrote them but could not run them

decision: the earlier-conversations dialog failed with Not connected when opened before the app connected; it now waits and loads on connect and on each reconnect
why: found by the app live check clicking right after load

decision: Haiku 5.5 refused a code-word recall and mangled a repeat-with-suffix probe; arithmetic on the last reply (512 -> 513) is the probe now
why: probes must not depend on how the model reads an instruction

decision: the phone's terminal never took input: Android's IPC carries JSON only, and terminal_write required a raw body; it now takes {id, data: number[]} everywhere
why: found on the real phone; emulation uses the desktop IPC
evidence: console warning terminal_write takes raw bytes; pane empty before, filled after

decision: U4 on the Nord with SwiftKey: terminal opens without the keyboard; tap opens it; row sits right above it; real-key s arrives at once (insertText, no composition); row Ctrl then real c clears the prompt; echo hi typed at human speed arrives exactly
why: the worker's three open questions need the real keyboard
evidence: app/e2e-android/android.spec.ts key row test pass; probe output

decision: SwiftKey capitalizes the first letter typed after the terminal opens, though the field asks for no capitals (inputType 0x200a1); later letters are fine
why: left as is: seeding the hidden textarea could make Gboard compose words, and only SwiftKey can be checked here
evidence: probe: after s -> S, echo hi -> echo hi

decision: keys injected by adb in one burst garble in xterm (42ab12cd -> 4abb12cd12cd2cdcdd) because its Android path diffs the textarea after a 0 ms timeout; human-speed typing does not
why: the device check types one key per adb call

decision: U5 on the Nord: list, approval, question and plan cards and the earlier-conversations dialog fit at 384 px in light and dark
why: the user asked to check dark mode and the cards on the phone
evidence: screenshots in job scratch, viewed cropped below the status bar

decision: dark mode already worked on the phone; Playwright emulates a light colour scheme when it attaches, which fooled a probe and the first screenshots; two theme changes were tried, disproven by a plain adb screenshot (page colour #262624 at night) and reverted
why: attack the premise after two fixes on one premise failed
evidence: logcat showed night=32 isLight=false; plain screencap dark

decision: a tap on a phone notification opened orfoni but not the session: tauri-plugin-notification's Android side never sets sourceJson, so the tap event carries notification null (2.7.0 and 2.8.0); orfoni's Kotlin plugin now shows phone notices, one per session, and Rust hands the tapped session to the page on window focus or at startup
why: RunEvent::Resumed fires only for the first native window on Android, WindowEvent::Focused fires on each return

decision: fresh reviewer (opus) over 2f3b2ef..HEAD: npm test exited 1 on unhandled unlisten rejections; the port live check still waited for a code word; a tap that cold-starts orfoni could lose its session
why: a second pair of eyes before the release
evidence: all three confirmed; the third went deeper than traced: Android restores the activity and delivers the tap via onNewIntent before the plugin loads

decision: U6 suites: unit 773 (exit 0), cargo 34, hub live 24/24, desktop Playwright 24 (2 failures rerun green: the port probe fixed, the task list one was haiku taking over 2 min), device 6/6 including the cold-start tap; settings unchanged after each
